answer_1.quote: we propose table-to-report, a novel task designed to convert structured tabular data into natural language reports

answer_2.quote: we propose an evaluation system for table-to-report generation, incorporating 3 carefully designed criteria: Numerical Accuracy Criterion (NAC), Information Coverage Criterion (ICC), and General Evaluation Criterion (GEC)

answer_3.quote: we propose the General Evaluation Criterion (GEC) to holistically assess report quality using LLMs as judges. GEC focuses on five key dimensions...

answer_4.quote: Another six independent annotators evaluated reports generated by five representative models... alongside human-written reports
answer_4.guideline: Evaluations followed criteria (NAC, ICC, GEC from Section 4)
